messages:
emma-support: Heads up — invoice INV-2026-432 for Coastline Health is blocked in billing. AR rejected settlement because PO not attached and VAT ID doesn't match records. Customer is pushing for Net30 or upfront payment, but our default for new enterprise accounts is Net45. Can someone advise next steps?

mike-ar: Pulling it up. amount $48,600, issued 2026-03-02. Payment attempt failed earlier (card attempt). Do we have the card decline details or a retry scheduled?

billing-bot: Payment processor response: 
```
status: failed
code: 402_CARD_DECLINED
txn_id: txn_8f3b2c
attempts: 1
```

sara-cs: Customer said they can provide a PO within 48 hours and will update VAT to match EU registry. They say finance policy requires Net30 for third-party vendors, otherwise they will require upfront. Asking for an exception.

mike-ar: Policy check — standard Net45 for new customers. Exceptions need AR manager sign-off + validated tax docs. If they provide PO and matching VAT ID, we can fast-track to Net30 pending internal credit check. Otherwise, offer a short-term provisional credit or request upfront payment.

emma-support: Any chance we can give provisional access so their integration isn't blocked? This is causing API errors on their side (retries causing spikes). Customer engineering pinged about 502s when invoices remain unpaid.

jordan-engineer: The 502s are from our webhook retry backlog — unrelated to auth but cascades when billing webhooks slow down. If billing marks invoice unpaid we can enable a limited quota bypass for 48h, but needs AR approval.

mike-ar: Proposed flow: 1) ask customer to upload PO + VAT proof in support portal (link: https://redwood.example/support/invoice/INV-2026-432). 2) If docs arrive within 48h, AR can provision Net30 hold pending credit check. 3) If they decline, require upfront payment or issue a 48h provisional quota with usage cap. Need manager sign-off for provisional credit.

sara-cs: I'll relay that — customer prefers Net30 and will try to upload PO today. They asked if we can attempt a second card charge after PO is attached.

mike-ar: Don't reattempt card until PO + VAT verified — risk of multiple declines affecting processor standing. I'll queue AR manager for sign-off: @emma-support can you ping @mike-ar-director?

emma-support: pinged manager in DMs, asked for quick decision. Also flagged this to legal for the VAT mismatch.

billing-bot: Note: next automatic retry scheduled in 24h unless AR changes invoice state.

mike-ar: Final: awaiting PO + VAT docs. If received, set invoice to "pending-net30" and notify billing to hold retries. If not received within 48h, send formal request for upfront payment and block provisioning. I'll update here once manager responds. :white_check_mark:
